chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 15 & 16: Inheritance & Environmental Ecology)
subject: biology-10

questions.question: The observable physical and morphological characteristics of an organism are termed its: (FBISE Annual 2024)
questions.explanation: The phenotype represents the outward physical expression of an organisms genetic constitution interacting with its environment.

questions.question: In a classical Mendelian monohybrid cross between two heterozygotes (Tt x Tt), what is the expected phenotypic ratio in F2? (FBISE 2023)
questions.explanation: Heterozygous monohybrid crosses yield a 3:1 phenotypic ratio (3 dominant : 1 recessive) and a 1:2:1 genotypic ratio.

questions.question: Which human blood group system demonstrates co-dominance in heterozygous individuals? (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Individuals with genotype IA IB express both A and B antigens equally on red blood cell membranes, exhibiting co-dominance.

questions.question: The complementary base pairing in a double-stranded DNA molecule dictates that Adenine always pairs with: (FBISE 2022)
questions.explanation: In DNA, Adenine binds Thymine via two hydrogen bonds (A=T), while Guanine pairs with Cytosine via three (G≡C).

questions.question: Which of the following is a classic example of continuous phenotypic variation in the human population?
questions.explanation: Continuous variations (height, weight, skin pigmentation) display a bell-shaped range of phenotypes governed polygenically.

questions.question: Who formulated the scientific theory of evolution by natural selection in 1859? (FBISE 2021)
questions.explanation: Charles Darwin published On the Origin of Species in 1859, proposing natural selection as the driving engine of evolution.

questions.question: In an ecosystem, autotrophic green plants and phytoplankton function ecologically as: (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Producers capture solar radiant energy to synthesize organic biomass, supporting all subsequent consumer trophic levels.

questions.question: According to the 10% ecological energy rule, approximately what fraction of usable energy is transferred between successive trophic levels?
questions.explanation: Roughly 90% of energy is lost as metabolic heat and waste, allowing only ~10% to be stored as consumable biomass in the next level.

questions.question: The symbiotic relationship between Rhizobium bacteria and leguminous root nodules where both partners benefit is: (FBISE 2023)
questions.explanation: Mutualism benefits both partners: Rhizobium fixes atmospheric nitrogen for the plant, receiving carbohydrates and shelter in return.

questions.question: Acid precipitation (acid rain) is primarily caused by atmospheric industrial emissions of: (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides react with water droplets in clouds to form dilute sulfuric and nitric acids, lowering rain pH below 5.6.

questions.question: The environmental phenomenon wherein greenhouse gases trap outgoing terrestrial infrared radiation to warm Earth is: (FBISE 2022)
questions.explanation: Atmospheric greenhouse gases absorb and re-emit longwave infrared radiation back to the surface, maintaining a habitable global temperature.

questions.question: Which wild spiral-horned mountain goat is protected as the national animal of Pakistan? (FBISE 2021)
questions.explanation: The Markhor (Capra falconeri) is Pakistans national animal, rigorously conserved in northern mountainous wildlife reserves.
